title: A Midsummer Night’s Dream
venue: Wagon Wheel Center for the Arts
description: Presented by Wagon Wheel Community Theatre Shakespeare’s beloved comedy gets an electrifying 1980s makeover! Four young lovers, a mischievous fairy, a troupe of bumbling actors, and a magical forest collide in a whirlwind of mistaken identities, enchantment, and laughter. Filled with romance, comedy, and retro flair, this vibrant production proves that true love has always been a little complicated.
